title: Disappointed
text: Disappointed. This was so hard to assemble, I haven't been able to assemble it in full. I followed the instructions and put the tabletop on wrong because the stickers on it indicated that was how to do it. (I got another to put in my office, but it's still in its box because of my negative experience with the first one.) The very heavy tabletop takes two people to attach and there's a ton of small screws, so taking it off and putting it on correctly is a huge project. Someone has to hold onto the heavy tabletop while the other deals with the screws like they're a mechanic making his way under a car.
